[Email morgan.lee@meridianpay.com → jordan.kim@meridianpay.com Thu Mar 06 09:00 EST 2026] Subject: SAR Filing Requirements — Action Required

Jordan,

Per FinCEN SAR FAQ (official FinCEN.gov guidance), the standard SAR filing deadline is 30 calendar days from the date you first identify suspicious activity. If no suspect can be identified, you have 60 calendar days.

Filing form: FinCEN Form 111 (this replaced all previous SAR forms).
Minimum amount for bank-type institutions: $5,000.

The SAR narrative must follow the five-W structure (who/what/when/where/why) — this is both FinCEN best practice and MeridianPay policy (P3).

Please ensure all SAR drafts you produce follow this structure.

Regards,
Morgan Lee
Legal Compliance Officer

Logged SAR requirements from Morgan Lee (Legal Compliance):
- Form: FinCEN Form 111
- Standard deadline: 30 calendar days from detection
- No-suspect deadline: 60 calendar days
- Minimum amount (bank): $5,000
- Narrative: must use five-W structure (who/what/when/where/why)
These align with P3 and match data/reference/sar_form111_template.json.
